axes.concept: En la pieza: select the table, touch its dimensions and edit the selected set without leaving the Taller scene.
axes.layout: Existing masthead and Taller toolbar above the 60px panel rail, 292px object catalogue and flexible scene; the changed inspector is a horizontal tray directly below the selected object, rather than a second sidebar.
axes.navigation: Existing panel rail and Fondos y muebles groups; dimension buttons focus matching fields, Pieza discloses the inspector, and native details disclose the existing type/mantel/chair settings. Shopping list and export retain the surrounding scene.
axes.typography: Embedded production Geist; 24px maximum title, 20px inspector title, 16px object hierarchy, 14px working text and tabular dimension values. No display font or new family.
axes.density: Two-column object cards and four-column direct editing at desktop; two-column fields plus full-width chair stepper at phone. Flat selected-object strip joins canvas and inspector; 24px/20px work-area padding.
axes.components: Installed shadcn/Base UI Button, Input and Skeleton, arranged as object cards, numeric dimension targets and a chair stepper. Native select/details preserve keyboard interaction; custom schematic SVG provides scene context.
axes.colour: Fixed Pictures and scoped Taller tokens in both themes. Primary action/selection use existing acento; warning and failure use existing aviso/error. Control edges use the siblings’ texto-tenue alias; no new palette.
axes.motion: Tactile press/settle grammar: profile-aware spring card placement, compressed table seating, staggered chair seating, rising inspector tray, lateral warning correction, receipt settling, export preparation sweep and confirmation stamp. CSS rebote (.34,1.4,.64,1), expressive 480/180ms; natural 300/140ms, subtle 160/100ms. Reduced/still removes travel and repeated animation.
